interpretations: Join `scanconservation.zoneref` to `sites.zoneregistry` with an inner join; group the matched conservation records by `sites.healtheval`, treating NULL as its own group; count records in each group and divide each count by the total matched record count; retain groups whose share exceeds the average share across all groups; return one row containing the unrounded average count, average share, and average excess share of the retained groups.
queries:
WITH group_counts AS (
    SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM scanconservation AS c
    INNER JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
group_shares AS (
    SELECT
        record_count,
        1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM group_counts
),
compared AS (
    SELECT
        record_count,
        share,
        AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM group_shares
)
SELECT
    AVG(record_count) AS average_count,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM compared
WHERE share > average_share
